description:
Before adding one new holding to an existing portfolio: how much of it is already
        owned through the current funds (from the fund's SEC filing when there is
        one), whether it adds an independent bet, and what past crises would have done
        with it included. Use it for one addition; for removing, reweighting or
        several changes at once, test_a_change. add is the ticker considered, amount
        how much of it in the same units as holdings, holdings what is owned now, base
        the currency (default USD). Counterfactual; never says whether to buy.

amount.description: How much of it, in the same units as `holdings` (money when holdings are amounts).
amount.title: Amount

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: weight or amount}. Weights need not sum to one; amounts in the base currency are also accepted (then the crises are shown in money). 1 to 100 holdings. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash).
holdings.title: Holdings

name: check_before_you_buy

outputSchema.description: One addition measured on the portfolio it would join (counterfactual).

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

crises.description: Per past crisis: fall before and after, as fractions.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

overlap.description: How much of it is already owned: kind (fund, stock, opaque); for a fund already_share (share of its money in companies already held), seen_share, shared ([company, weight in it, weight in the portfolio]), source, as_of; for a stock already (share of the portfolio) and via.

top_risk.description: The holding carrying the most risk, and its share, before and after.

title: Check before you buy
